what: R Client for the OPAS ISPRA Air Quality Web Service
title: R Client for the OPAS ISPRA Air Quality Web Service
text: ropas R client OPAS (OPen Air System) REST API. package provides access OPAS web-service endpoints : station metadata; parameter metadata; data series catalogues; hourly daily measurements; incremental synchronisation endpoints; pre-computed annual statistics regulatory limit reference tables. OPAS used Italian environmental agencies. ropas assume OPAS represents full official national air-quality network; simply provides R interface available API endpoints.

text: Interactive workflows can use: Authentication state stored internally current R session used automatically API functions. advanced process-based parallel workflows, use explicit authentication object: Functions support auth argument can receive object explicitly, avoiding reliance package-global authentication state worker processes: can retrieve current internal authentication state : Logout clears local authentication state attempts server-side logout best-effort basis:

title: Retrieve OPAS time series measurements — opas_get_data
code: opas_get_data(   series_id,   start = NULL,   end = NULL,   last_hours = NULL,   last_days = NULL,   daily = FALSE,   auth = NULL )

title: Retrieve OPAS time series measurements — opas_get_data
text: series_id Integer. Series identifier returned opas_series (series_id column). start, end Start end requested period.  Accepted inputs: POSIXct object. character string ISO 8601 format "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS", interpreted UTC+1 fixed ("Etc/GMT-1"). must supplied together. last_hours Integer. Return data last N hours. Mutually exclusive last_days start/end. last_days Integer. Return daily-aggregated data last N days.  Mutually exclusive last_hours start/end. daily Logical. using custom start/end range, set TRUE use daily-aggregated endpoint (/series-data-dd/) instead raw hourly one (/series-data/).  Ignored last_hours last_days supplied. auth Optional object returned opas_auth. supplied, used instead package-global authentication state. useful process-based parallel workflows.

title: Retrieve OPAS time series measurements — opas_get_data
text: tibble one row per measurement, including: datetime POSIXct UTC+1 fixed ("Etc/GMT-1"), derived measure_date_time.  See note timestamps Details section. value_raw measure_value returned API; source column measure_value dropped. post_validity_code Primary validity flag provided API (0 = valid, 1 = reconstructed, negative = invalid). series_id, station_id, station_name, parameter_name, parameter_unit Series context columns, prepended convenience. parameter_unit raw measurement unit returned data endpoint. ... remaining API fields except measure_value measure_date_time, replaced value_raw datetime respectively.

title: Retrieve OPAS time series measurements — opas_get_data
text: Recent hours: supply last_hours. Recent days (daily-aggregated endpoint): supply last_days. Custom range: supply start end. Use daily = TRUE hit daily-aggregated endpoint instead raw hourly one. Note measure_value: API returns raw instrument values.  function exposes value_raw.  Conversion metadata available catalogue endpoints opas_series opas_parameters.  Automatic conversion intentionally left higher-level helper functions. Note validity: filter post_validity_code keep records trust: 0 = valid, 1 = reconstructed, negative = invalid. Note timestamps: measure_date_time strings returned OPAS API carry explicit timezone offset always represent Italian standard time (UTC+1 fixed, daylight saving), confirmed ISPRA developers.  consistent legal reference time required D.Lgs. 155/2010 EU Directive 2024/2881.  datetime column parsed tz = "Etc/GMT-1". daily aggregates (last_days daily = TRUE), record timestamped midnight (00:00:00) reference day.

title: Retrieve OPAS time series measurements — opas_get_data
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Last 24 hours opas_get_data(12900, last_hours = 24)  # Last 7 daily aggregates opas_get_data(12900, last_days = 7)  # Custom range (raw hourly) opas_get_data(12900,               start = "2026-01-01T00:00:00",               end   = "2026-02-01T00:00:00")  # Custom range (daily aggregates) opas_get_data(12900,               start = "2026-01-01T00:00:00",               end   = "2026-02-01T00:00:00",               daily = TRUE)  # Stateless authentication object, useful in parallel workflows auth <- opas_auth("user@arpa.fvg.it", "my_password") opas_get_data(12900, last_hours = 24, auth = auth) } # }

title: ropas: R Client for the OPAS ISPRA Air Quality Web Service — ropas-package
text: Provides R interface OPAS (OPen Air System) REST API exposed ISPRA (Istituto Superiore per la Protezione e la Ricerca Ambientale).
